mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE exceeds 5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which depresses earnings for industrial firms and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by more than 1% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contractions exceeding 1% for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening of monetary policy and accelerating inflation, which erodes real corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated monthly increase of at least 1% in both real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS) and retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise by at least 1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during episodes where both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise by at least 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the unemployment rate below 4% for six consecutive months indicates an overheating labor market, which typically precedes restrictive monetary policy and wage inflation, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in the absence of concurrent recession signals.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 6 consecutive months and no concurrent GDP contraction
regime_hint: tight labor market without GDP contraction
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4% for six consecutive months and GDPC1 does not contract.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average for eight consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month moving average for 8 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during eight consecutive months of HOUST below its 12-month moving average.
